description: Isaac Newton Group of Telescopes (La Palma) filter database: throughput scans of ING-owned broad- and narrow-band filters used at the INT, WHT and JKT, by ING serial number.
short_description: Isaac Newton Group (La Palma) filter database, by serial number
facility_description: Isaac Newton Group of Telescopes (INT, WHT, JKT), Roque de los Muchachos, La Palma.

licence.terms: "Filter Database © 2006 Isaac Newton Group of Telescopes Developed by Robert Greimel, Samantha Rix, Javier Méndez" (footer of https://astro.ing.iac.es/filter/; no data licence found)
licence.scope: Footer of the filter-database page, not a data licence. Hosted under Nill's 2026-10-26 'host everything' decision.

notes: The ING page: 'The ING owns a large collection of broad and narrow band filters'. Per-filter text files (catserver.ing.iac.es/filter/filtercurve.php?format=txt&filter=N) no longer answer (HTTP 500 at astro.ing.iac.es); Internet Archive snapshots (2010-2011) were used. Each file records the filter name, system, passband, FWHM, cosmetics and scan date. SVO lists these as energy counters; here DetectorType=photon is assumed (CCD imaging).
